notes.title: The VVIP Update is Here
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers,[/h1][p]
[/p][p]It’s been an eventful year for our team, launching Spirit Swap, and we’re so happy to share that it’s getting even more exciting! We’ve been working since launch to add a bevy of updates for you to enjoy ~  
[/p][h2]Our [i]VVIP Update [/i]is here! [/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/bf4b22ae3627130efb2546af317ef4ec5621de17.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What does that mean?[/h3][p]This is a free update for everyone who has the game! Story Mode is getting new (voiced!) content so you can spend a special evening with your fave Demashq residents. Once you’ve completed your 5-heart event with each character, get ready to celebrate a night on the town and FINALLY see 5HAGVISION live ~ fingers crossed no spirits interrupt the show! In addition to that, we’ve got fashion and fresh characters added to Endless Mode and more.
[/p][p]Overall, here’s what you’ll find:
[/p][list][*][p][b]Head backstage with VVIP tickets! [/b]Finally take your bestie (or a hot date) to the show of the season -- that’s right, you’ll get to attend a 5HAG VISION concert! Let’s just hope the spirits stay on their plane of existence…[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Enjoy Endless Mode in Style. [/b]Swap out Samar’s outfits and even other characters to play as your faves. It's purely cosmetic, so swap as whoever you like![/p][/*][*][p][b]Be unchill with more Versus skin options.[/b] Challenge your friends as the original crew, with Samar's new outfits, or even as the new band members![/p][/*][*][p][b]Unleash your inner decorator[/b]. With more furniture to unlock once you complete the finale, there’s even more ways to make Samar’s room truly representative of their taste. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Savor new CGs.[/b] Pretty pictures of your favorite Demashq residents. What’s NOT to love? [/p][/*][/list][p]*Please note that the Mac build is on it's way: it should be ready in 1-2 days! Thank you for your patience![/p][p]
🥳 We also wanted to share a special thank you to every one who’s continued to play, post content, share thoughts, and leave reviews -- every bit of feedback has been instrumental to us as we’ve worked on getting this update out. Thank you! 
[/p][h3]Update Change Log[/h3][p]For everyone wanting the specific notes, here they are:
[/p][list][*][p]Added a new, fully voiced finale after you reach max affection (5 hearts) with any character! You can attend the finale multiple times, and invite anyone whose affection is maxed out. Every character has a new CG you can unlock, and we hope you enjoy the ending![/p][/*][*][p]Optimized our Swapping engine! Gameplay should be much smoother and have a better frame rate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the game opening in incorrect resolutions (e.g. 1024 x 768 or 800x600).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some settings not saving (e.g. button prompt style) across play sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]New skins and outfits in Versus Mode. When selecting some of the characters in the Versus character select screen, you'll see an additional button prompt over their avatar to switch between skins/characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless now allows you to play as anyone! It's purely a cosmetic change, so swap as whomever you'd like, including the five members of the band and five outfit changes for Samar.[/p][/*][*][p]New furniture pieces added. Once you complete the finale, those new options will unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated our end credits. They're now after the finale (and we've added additional folks who've supported us with this update!) 
 [/p][/*][/list][h3]Wholesome Games Celebration![/h3][p]
To make the update even MORE exciting, we're also taking part in the Wholesome Games’ Celebration! 

For anyone who hasn't picked up the game quite yet, now’s the perfect time to do so as we’ll be on sale (20% off!) starting today (August 7th) until August 14th! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a2c3794227ec1849704d995a5a6199bc921db1ca.gif"][/img][/p][p]And, of course, be sure to check out all the other wholesome and cozy games out there on sale and premiering this week ~ there are so many incredible teams and titles to support.[/p][p] [/p][p]Happy swapping! 🥰 [/p][p]
[/p][p]💕 The Spirit Swap Team[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Week 1 Recap!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Swappers![/h1]

It’s been officially one week since you’ve all started swapping ~ we hope you’re having an incredible time!

We’ve all been chatting and lurking in streams, watching videos, and taking notes on all of your feedback and reactions to the game, and wanted to share what we’ve been working on in regards to bug fixes and polish since launch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/dfc84fde8393782747830240339b2569384b90d8.png[/img]

[h2]Kickstarter Backers: Let us know if you didn’t get your key! [/h2]

As a general reminder, you should have your Steam keys by now! If you haven’t seen your key yet, please make sure to: 
[olist]
[*] [b]Remember if you participated in the Beta[/b] ~ if so, you already have your key! Just right click on the game in your library, go to Properties > Betas > Select “none” on the dropdown menu. The game should update to the full release version. 
[*] [b]Check your spam folder[/b] -- it may have ended up there - to help with the search, please note all the keys were send on Feb 3rd! And, if you still can't find it...
[*] [b]Email contact@softnotweak.com[/b] -- It’ll help if you can include the email you used when backing the Kickstarter and/or your Backer number! 
[/olist]
[h2]Thank you for helping us get to 80+ Steam Reviews![/h2]

WAHOO! Our first milestone goal was around 50 by the first week, and we’re already almost to 100?! Y’all are the best! 

If you've been playing and haven't yet left a review, please consider doing so!

As a reminder, leaving Steam Reviews for indie games is one of the best ways to help out post-launch if you enjoyed what you played! It can help us get more visibility (algorithmically but also for future Steam-related opportunities) and reviews help us when talking with other potential partners (like publishers, funds, or even merch folks!) 🥳

[h2]Bug Fixes & Updates[/h2]

These issues shouldn’t [i]bug [/i] you anymore! Here’s the list of all the fixes and polish we’ve just pushed to the game. We're not done yet, though, so please continue to share any bugs and feedback via our [url=https://bit.ly/SpiSwaBugReport]bug report form[/url] and Discord!

Without further ado, today's fixes include: 

[list]
[*] Run in Background enabled, default screen mode set to Fullscreen Window (i.e. Borderless Window)
[*] Minor difficulty decrease to Spicy and Sheesh 
[*] Edited for misspellings in events and character descriptions 
[*] Edited for colored text readability 
[*] Skip button is now hold-to-use, starts slower, accelerates, and is on E/Right Bumper
[*] Fixed Timekeeper not working properly in Endless mode 
[*] Added a pop-up before the credits roll to make it clearer that the game continues afterwards 
[*] Fixed achievements being delayed 
[*] "Gimme Variety" achievement is fixed, and should unlock retroactively
[*] Fixed typo in credits and included missing Witch on High tier
[*] Limited Refresh Rates available in Resolution Settings to only the current monitors refresh rate
[*] Remove refresh rate display on Resolution Settings (we now just take whatever the current monitor is)
[*] Fixed Samar, Dio, Cleo, and Theo individually being counted as part of the total affection count leading to improper progress display.
[*] Fixed fast as f*ck display check not functioning
[/list]

[b]Again, find a bug? Let us know![/b]
The best place to let us know? [url=https://bit.ly/SpiSwaBugReport]This bug report form[/url]! 

[h2]REMINDER: Get your own Froggo 🐸 [/h2]

The Makeship campaign is LIVE and only has 14 days left! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/8ee2480f98355dee7ad0a3e281bc68d631c42297.png[/img]

Check out the page [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/froggo]here[/url] and you can pre-order a Froggo of your very own (cheeks and all!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/c6cc279634e58b8e85fb54e271ac0b71b8502735.jpg[/img]

The campaign will only fund and ship if we make it to the goal of 200 Froggos pre-ordered, and we're already just over 20% funded, so be sure to get that in ahead of the deadline to help ensure it becomes a reality!

Again, we've been SO over the moon with how the reception has been. From cosplay, fanart, snippets of fanfic, and even the first ever Spirit Swap tournament (!!!), you've made this a truly special experience. 

Can't wait to share more about the upcoming update 🤩 But that'll be for next time! Thanks, and stay tuned ~ until then, keep swapping!

💗💗💗 The Spirit Swap team

notes.title: Under 30 Days to Launch 👀✨
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Swappers![/h1]


Happy New Year! The holiday decor is stored, snacks eaten, and we are under 30 days (!!!) until we launch Spirit Swap. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/85fdbc25ccba1115cd74f4d5d3f11bfbf6099be0.png[/img]

Ahead of the launch, we wanted to share our plans for the game: what you can expect upon release and beyond! It’s -- hopefully -- also our chance to share a little bit more behind-the-scenes and what we’ve learned as we’ve done this first game together as a team for those interested in a little of what it takes to make a game in 2025.

[h2]Our major post-launch update will include Fashion 🌸[/h2]

With this update, you’ll be able to dress up Samar in a selection of outfits to swap in style!

While we wish we could have included Fashion in the game's 1.0 launch, the reality is that making a game is expensive—even more so because one of our tenants as a co-op is to pay all of our contractors living wages, thus expanding our costs a bit more. Adding this feature in post-launch content allows us to get that final bit of funds to help pay our contractors and get the feature to you in a quality state. 

We already have some of the outfit concepts from our Backers done -- while we won’t show you what we ARE using, here’s an example of two that didn’t quite make the cut…and one that did! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ec1de0db805c1635d763bd22e58b7999de994416.png[/img]

Our plan is to get this post-launch update out in 2025, and once we have a more solid date, you bet we’ll be shouting it from the rooftops! 

[h2]We had to say goodBHY to BHYG mode [/h2]

One of the realities of game development is scope. It’s one of the tried and true tenets that if you’re making a game, you should scope down…and then scope down again. While we initially thought our scope could account for a BHYG Mode (an 8-player versus frenzy), once we got into development and discussion over it these last few months, it ended up not panning out in terms of what we could finish -- and polish -- to the quality that we hoped to achieve. 

Now, will BHYG Mode someday make its way back into the world of Spirit Swap? We won’t lie: we’d love to try our hand at it again in the future, perhaps if the funding, time, and stars align. But, at the moment, we’re saying goodBHY to this game mode, and plan on focusing more on making the features we DO have in the game as solid as possible!

[h2]Continuing to Finesse[/h2]

Some of the things we have been spending our time finessing include ensuring we have a variety of features to help folks play how they want to. So, we thought we’d spend a little time checking out the Settings tab!

One of the first settings we have to help folks out is the ability to manipulate saturation -- to help ease eye strain. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ca509d3271e80e5f610bb8601091545d26b3234e.gif[/img]

We’ve also included text animation! The game’s text waves, shakes, and even changes color to help ensure that visually -- not just auditorily -- you can sense how the tone of the conversation is going. 

The story log is also implemented if you need to take a look back at what was said in the latest scene:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7189e3841a06cc3555785cd34da2098896b7144e.png[/img]

We’ve even included a different style of spirit (harkening back to the OG Panel de Pon days) for folks who prefer that visual style. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/ef23be622d3e087dd108d0fb5eebe46cecbffbc7.gif[/img]

Finally, we’ve also added the “Skip this Round” button to the pause screen. We know sometimes you just wanna get to the story, or perhaps you’re just not feeling it that round. You can always skip and move on to the next round (or just skip them all and not do the match entirely). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/6c38003f7f4af0e1df0d98dcaf6eaa6f1518ae69.png[/img]

These are just a few of the additions we’ve included, and we’re continuing to polish polish polish! Our main priority right now is going through and playing the game as much as possible, trying to catch everything we can ahead of Feb 3rd. 


[h2]Say hello to an IRL Froggo [/h2]

We do have some exciting news on the Froggo front! Over the past few months, we’ve been working with the Makeship crew to design a Froggo plush so you can have a FamiliarZ of your very own to chill with. Check out the page here (and be sure to visit it on Feb 3rd if you’d like to pick a Froggo for yourself)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/2f97210a4e7270e90480f250609479ae71ed85f8.jpg[/img]

For those unfamiliar with Makeship, it’s a crowdfunding campaign-based plushie company. During a campaign, if we reach our goal of pre-orders for the plushie, then it becomes a reality! They will take care of all the manufacturing, shipping, and fulfillment. We’ve already got an adorable design, and can’t wait to share the unredacted image with you all soon. 

That’s it for this month’s update! We’re working hard and can’t believe the day is almost here! Feb 3, here we gooooo~ 

<3 The Spirit Swap team

notes.title: Getting closer to smooches 😚
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers,[/h1]

Two weeks have passed in the blink of an eye, and it’s time for our first update since the Backer Beta has gone live! Today will be a quicker update, showing off a succession of screenshots (ooo!) and gifs (aah!) of the polish and fixes we’ve done based on the feedback we’ve received. 

[h2]Deepen Your Relationships: B Supports are IN![/h2]

In the first version of the Beta, we only included the initial round of main narrative events -- what we’ve been calling internally the “C Supports”. These events with each character helped you meet them and get to know them. A little sampling. A taste test, if you will. Now? You can deepen those relationships further because we’ve added each character's second tier of main events. Their B Supports! Here are screenshots of a few B support moments now implemented into the game ~ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/fc394e7cd0a2a3ae10aedbec837017020231bd8c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/54d4a89818f910d5f28284fa829270537e864d20.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/d8cae34392ec439d1edc4c2391a9d19d3e0962b6.png[/img]

The B Supports are especially significant because at the end of each character’s B Support event, you get to pick whether or not you’d like to move forward platonically or romantically with each character (with one exception). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7eace6d25c753a55a627ce0049d58f103431f0db.gif[/img]

Next up for implementation? The A Supports, the final main tier for each character arc! Wahooo!

[h2]Who’s Who & Text Log[/h2]

It’s not implemented yet, but we’re working on a “Who’s Who” modal to help you keep track of your besties, as well as a “Log” so if you need to refresh yourself on the details of a convo, you’ve got it at your fingertips!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/64937af09495d37e5d19621322a73293fd509681.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Updates and Fixes ✨[/h2]

There are a bunch of details that we’ve been fixing up and working on based on our own internal testing as well as bug reports and feedback from the beta backers. A few of the highlights?

Fixed the “Got Item” screen to include dynamic text input (here’s a stinky test example for you):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/500153e695085ab3e152c53f49ec9803b0f696d9.gif[/img]

Added Stereo/Mono speaker configuration to Audio Settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/5b7d13f671f36605db0aa412868f8f236b109f10.png[/img]

Added Visual Saturation settings to decrease the saturation of all visuals (to help with eye strain):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/4006221537ea9c48c511e9cb7031a79021ba5dd3.gif[/img]

We’ll share another update in a few weeks -- between A Supports coming soon, as well as finishing out the Room Hub, we've got a lot going into the build through the rest of October. Talk soooon!

Love, 

The Spirit Swap team

notes.title: Fresh Spirit Swap Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers,[/h1]

We wanted to make sure that everyone got a hefty update about what we’re up to, as it’s been a minute. Two or three minutes, really! We mentioned this in our recent Kickstarter Backer’s update, but want to reiterate it here more widely: 

The year has been full of hard work as well as personal heartache and challenges for the team. We’re truly appreciative that you’ve all been patient and kind as we navigate this wonderful thing called ‘game development’ while maintaining our day jobs, and, well, everything.

One of the rewards for Kickstarter Backers who supported at the Witch’s Groove tier and beyond was exclusive access to a Spirit Swap Backer Beta, and we’re proud to say that we’ve reached that milestone! The Backer Beta is live today (we’re pushing it out and sending keys RIGHT NOW), and we’re officially coming out of heads-down mode to share what we’ve been working on over the last year, both in terms of development and regarding our launch plans. But first? Some enticing gifs for youuuu ~ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/1a3cfb50b0f2bb865caa7b0fbc29e8e3ebca02a2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/16b14ade4327dbb92218c4d1d1e083a689df3113.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/d12eacf1bd8a20beb81241ada4c1c41faa2305c6.gif[/img]

[i]Please note: if you are a Kickstarter Backer at the Witch's Groove tier (and above) and you haven't received your beta key by around 10 am PST today, check your spam folder (just in case) and then feel free to reach out to us at contact (at) softnotweak (dot) com.[/i]

[h2]Check, check, 1…2…3…[/h2]

The VO is finally totally implemented, and it’s incredible to see (hear?) each of our characters come to life. We had eight talented voice actors contribute their skills to this endeavor, and wanted to take the time to introduce each of them to you with one of their Versus lines in the game. [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sYBIjLt8FRBg3MPkn982P90lwVx8sOyW/view?usp=drive_link]Iskandar[/url] - [url=https://twitter.com/voiceofgreyson]Greyson Yousif[/url]

What’s that, you say? Some of these names don’t have links? And you don't know who those unlinked characters are?!

👀 [i]We’re still keeping some snippets under wraps and saved for later ~ [/i]

[h2]Make it shine[/h2]

Continued polish is the big focus now. During the backer beta (which is from September 17 - November 12), we’ll be taking feedback to continue to shine up every aspect of the game that we can, adding details to really make it feel great to play. Here are some of the bits of polish we’ve added (and are working to add):


A snazzy “Got Item” pop up so you can really celebrate the gifts your friends give you!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/6f5abcbdcbfa95a129b295d805fd73a81815b24f.png[/img]

More expressions, like this panicked Lulu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/64bb53f0f200145a4c59bcda957f7795031efe0f.png[/img]

….and this INTENSE Lulu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7eb32db44ab30ae48f9f7b14e4478e62090729ef.png[/img]

Exploring more ways to add more information to the world map so you can keep track of how you’re spending your time in Demashq. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/f761a3d202137b5d166006ef9ead32aebb4fcbe3.png[/img]

And more!

[h2]Wait! What about Fashion and BHYG Mode?[/h2]

They’re still coming along! These two elements are still planned, but their complexity means they’ll likely be included in an update not too long after the main launch of the game.

[h2]A new trailer is in the works[/h2]

What’s that? A fresh trailer? YUP! We are in the process of getting ready to announce the release date, which means storyboarding and starting to prep the launch trailer. For funsies, here’s a sneak peek at a favorite early WIP storyboard frame…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/fc28005c69c6b3839a479385e4e39388d374182d.png[/img]
Blurry, chaotic, and cute. Very relatable.

…and the turnaround of Samar that Sam has been working on:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/2465f6e532eca500d103ef9b525e296c0b71fdf0.png[/img]

[h2]So, when is the full game coming out? [/h2]

When deciding when to release the game, we’re not only take into account when the game is done -- we’re also tracking other game releases and event opportunities that can help us reach the most folks with the news. 

Because of a few opportunities we’re aiming for (and for a bit of a full circle moment for ourselves), we’ve decided to release in early 2025. We’re tossing around a couple of specific dates, and depending on what additional support we can garner, that may impact which one we go with. (hee hee hee ho ho ho, marketing witchcraft and secrets) 

As soon as we can share an official date, we will let you know! But for now, we sincerely hope that you’ve enjoyed this update. We’ll be aiming to post monthly again now that we’re in the midst of the Backer Beta. 

Have fun in Demashq!  

💜 The Spirit Swap team



PS: SPEEEEENING
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/3051e6ef4e28744747a4a88c677fa91bc8fd0ce8.gif[/img]

notes.title: Merry Monday!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/fdf2489e23ab0f7944e5a1b4e5bb71ec78bbed83.png[/img]

[h1]Hi Spirit Swappers![/h1]

We have emerged! It’s now spring, and like the beautiful butterfly, we

Wait. 

While yes, we are emerging like beautiful butterflies with lots of cool things to share, we also wanted to say that it’s been a while because we’ve been heads down developing Spirit Swap in addition to balancing our day jobs and Life(™). 

We’re sorry for the quiet period, but happy to say that we’ve gotten to a point in the game’s progress where we’re able to hop back into sharing mode. We’ve got a lot, so let’s get started!

[h2]Polish Till It Shines! 👀[/h2]

Updated environments? IN!
World map? DONE. 
Amazing emotes? CHECK. 
Gradients for days? YES.

In addition to working on core features, a good chunk of time has been on polishing and making sure the game looks colorful, joyful, and full of that *special sauce*. 

We could just sit here and describe it all to you, but I remember learning in 5th grade about ‘showing, not telling’ so why not show you a few gifs to illustrate what we mean? 

Just as a reminder, check out our world map before:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/5af611f6928f7b73e35d041ed2f437631e6c0028.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/c2644547fb02d50b70bf9cdef9bb9863428486e1.png[/img]

And here it is NOW: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a77b379177ee74829f0a2f9de655bd98e56f1a34.gif[/img]

We LOVE how it’s turned out, and would love to know: where would you want to head to first? 
All the environments and locations have also been updated and fully implemented, like Leon’s Tattoo Parlor:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/999ba99f4e28a7563653363a5925b3630e4ca86d.gif[/img]

And here’s the updated take on Ishk’s Beach!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/e63ed741cf01c6c59293361562566b90204908b7.gif[/img]

Now that the world is all there, what we’ll be focusing on is getting all of the narrative in, and testing, testing, testing.

[h2]Once Upon a Time … [/h2]

Speaking of narrative! Alex has been finessing the story of Spirit Swap, and while we can’t tell you TOO much about the specifics (this is a spoiler-free zone!) we CAN share this: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/d444c57e16fe607af49e14c56475fd14a46df02a.png[/img]

Okay, jokes aside, we’ve been really pleased with how each of our characters have come to life -- in addition to getting the story into the game to playtest it, finalizing VO is also up next, and we can’t wait for that!

[h2]Versus Hype[/h2]

In addition to working on story mode, Versus has been getting lots of UI/UX love so you can swap your hearts out (either with a friend or with a CPU!) 

Check out this character select screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/153f18b605bcc4a0253da580814eff81cb9b8b8f.gif[/img]

And as you pick your characters, you’ll be able to customize how chill (or not!) you’d like your board to be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/20c3a3e8ab530bc63f195168ad3e23e5d7a81fea.gif[/img]

[h2]Out on the Town[/h2]

Rejon and Jenny attended GDC! 

Rejon gave an INCREDIBLE (actually got people teary) talk about Spirit Swap titled “Inclusive Nostalgia” as part of a wider panel titled “Game Design for Inclusive Representation”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/f13a3021e786aba8d933f3312ca8503d270f944e.png[/img]

Jenny - along with the rest of the Wholesome Games team - talked about why wholesome games matter: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/73210df3bede13490dc5a0cf823b3821764d084e.png[/img]

The SpiSwa team also got to hang out with Adanna and Jenna (members of the Spirit Swap narrative team) for the first time ever in-person, enjoying some delicious ramen together! ;-; <3

[h2]See you next month[/h2]

WHEW! We’re excited to really ramp up sharing news with you all now that spring has sprung. Thanks for all your patience, and we’ll be back with more dev updates at the end of May!

Until then, find us on Twitter, our Discord, or here in the comments if you have any questions. Stay hydrated and safe!


Love, 

The Spirit Swap Team

notes.title: Flashy Friday!
notes.content:
[h1]Leaves are falling and the spirits need swapping…[/h1]

It’s been an eventful time for the Soft Not Weak team! We’ve been busy at work polishing up some LOVELY snippets to show off, and we boy oh boy are we excited to show them off! In addition to that, we have an UPDATED DEMO for you all to try! Ready? Set? GOOOOOOOO: 

[h2]Indieland 2022 and our UPDATED DEMO![/h2]

[b]First things first! We’re lucky and honored to be a part of [url=https://www.twitch.tv/TheCompletionist]Indieland 2022[/url]! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/acaa85d96706d73dd7061feb6797b6c36fba110a.jpg[/img]

Not only is this event an amazing fundraiser for a good cause, but Jirard and the team behind Indieland always curate a fantastic showcase filled with indie games to keep an eye on.

To celebrate, [b]we’ve decided to release an updated Endless mode demo,[/b] chock full of polish and juice we’ve been working on to help bring Samar’s forest to life! Below we’ll break down a lot of the details that you’ll see, but if you’re itching to get going, you can start playing the demo now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592170/Spirit_Swap_Lofi_Beats_to_Match3_To/

A couple of additional notes about the demo:
[list]
[*] For MAC users: Some Mac users might encounter controller issues due to Mac driver compatability. If that occurs, please use the keyboard!
[*] For Keyboard: You can use WASD or ARROW keys to navigate as well the inputs described in game! 
[/list]

Otherwise, read on to learn about what we’ve been working on, and tune in to Twitch on Saturday at 7 PM PDT to watch as Jenny (our producer) chats with the team at Indieland about Spirit Swap! 

[h2]Polish Based on Your Feedback![/h2]

Okay, so first thing is we’ve been doing a lot of UI/UX polish (major shoutout to [url=https://twitter.com/Maximum_Crash]Réjon[/url] for all of the work designing this and to Morgan for hooking it all together). We really wanted to make sure that different elements of the game, different states of play, all of it will be communicated to you as clearly and quickly as possible. 

This began with the game board! Because your eyes will be focusing on the spirits, you need to be able to, at a glance and with your peripheral vision, be able to determine your health and general status. Here, we have our latest iteration of the board:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/0841640b91cfbde04ad5c5f22a2c29a31b274028.gif[/img]

You’ll be able to tell when it’s getting a little hot and you’ve gotta make some matches and quick, as well as see when everything’s a-okay and you have time to chill. 

Elements like the SpellMeter have been updated to also more clearly indicate as segments fill when you make matches: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/1a96d89b08b597e0fcff4eda1cb440075c785907.gif[/img]

Even the spell bubble has some extra polish so you know when it’s time to cast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/7e516058185b87531f0c3e80f184df523430e17f.gif[/img]

[h2]Press ESC to pet the Frog[/h2]

We’ve also been working on dynamic button prompts, which was another big feedback point during our previous survey and demo (thanks, y’all!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/47529454719e88967d41d914d5221aa9cd2b0046.gif[/img]

We now have the ability to make those buttons match whatever controller you’re using, and it’ll switch to match dynamically as well! Catch how this dialogue looks in action with a few snips from our revamped “How to Play” section of the Endless demo: 

[h2]Take a Breath in the Endless Forest[/h2]

You’re familiar with the Endless Forest, as it’s where our demo takes place… but you haven’t seen it quite like this! 

The original background is beautiful, but with just a little bit of parallaxing, and some time and energy, we’ve got it looking more in-depth in time for your eyes to enjoy -- huge thanks to [url=https://twitter.com/abellehayford]Abelle[/url] for adding that extra magic and style to the woods (and our other backgrounds).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/45ac0c0865b2f94660fa36f0a8f933168d76fafa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Vibe? Chill? SHEEESH?![/h2]

Here’s a more comprehensive look at the settings in our Endless mode. When you’re getting ready to swap forever, you’ll be able to adjust the speed level, difficulty, and spell loadouts before you play, to ensure it’s exactly the experience you want. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/d195f21fb6240ac538ae7e034b92de5363fd5e91.gif[/img]

[h2]AND MORE![/h2]
There’s even more to enjoy, like [b]a brand-new song from the ever-talented [url=https://twitter.com/meltycanon]meltycanon[/url][/b], additional VN UI/UX updates to make our cast *pop* during narrative scenes, and (if you’d love to help us) a brand new survey you can fill out to let us know what you think of the polish after you play! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/cc38af52174472ce2a0d8ecb58e91d52440e0439.gif[/img]

[h2]What do you think? [/h2]

Hopefully you enjoyed seeing everything we’ve been working on! We love sharing with you and are so excited to hear what you think about the polish we’ve added to the Endless mode demo. If you’ve got any questions or just wanna say hi, find us on Twitter (@softnotweak), our Discord, or here in the comments!


Love, 

The Spirit Swap Team

notes.title: June 2022: Demo Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]The demo is live! [/b][/h1]

We’re really looking forward to hearing your thoughts on the [b]narrative demo that we’ve shared for Spirit Swap [/b]-- and if you’ve played it, please remember to fill out the feedback form (found [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeRroFCrudpqtStjxK-vDSZqN_q0plfNsj6aGAjDyFf36Dzfw/viewform][b]here[/b][/url]). 

This demo is still a work-in-progress toward our final vision of Spirit Swap, and we wanted to illuminate a few details for you: some larger bugs and polish we’re aware of and still working on…and even ~secrets~ you can try out if you’re looking for a challenge!

[h2]UI/UX: Input [/h2]

We’re working on making sure the control schemes are consistently displayed in the demo: right now, they switch between keyboard and gamepad (which is good for keeping you on your toes, but not for clarity!)  

Here’s a quick overview of controls:

[b]Keyboard Controls:[/b]
 
WASD or Arrow Keys -- Move cursor
J / Space  -- Confirm (dialogue and swap) 
SHIFT / K / ALT -- cast spell 
ESC -- Pause


[b]Gamepad Controls: [/b]

D-pad -- Move cursor
A/B -- Confirm (dialogue and swap)
X/Y -- cast spell
LB/RB - Raise Board
Start -- Pause

[h2]Space: The Final Frontier[/h2]

If you hit space during the loading screen, you may progress the visual novel dialogue, so spam space (or A) at your own risk! 

[h2]Audio Issues? Just Restart![/h2]

While we think we may have squashed this bug, we’d love to give a heads up in case you happen to experience this! If you don’t hear any audio in the title screen (specifically the background music), try quitting out of the demo and re-opening. That should do the trick!


[h2]Secret Spells[/h2]

If you’ve played the demo, you’ve seen the Square spell...but did your eagle eyes notice two other spell shapes to the right and left of the trusty SQUARE spell during the tutorial? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/5b8283e77d11c3b20f21965df0a73a0d321836c2.png[/img]

If you’re looking for a special challenge, you can try out these two secret spells: Diamond and X!

They’re implemented in the demo, and technically playable, but we didn’t want to (officially) tutorialize and test them quite yet…but, who’re we to stop you if you wanted to give ‘em a try? 

If you’re wanting to step up your swapping game, the shapes you need to make to cast DIAMOND and X are listed below (the red shapes indicate the same color spirits that must be placed):

DIAMOND
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/77a83ec9ce31ddaec99e81608de64b90daa3a6aa.png[/img]

X
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/e44db1f01c8a7ed112a31cf9c05fbcc658e50177.png[/img]

Like the SQUARE spell, both cost one bar on the Spellmeter to cast! 
Enjoy, and let us know if you happen to cast one (or both!) successfully!

[h2]Thank you![/h2]

If you want to chat with us, you can always hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/pSYhWbq2J8]Discord[/url], find us on [url=https://twitter.com/softnotweak]Twitter[/url], or send us an email at contact@softnotweak.com!

notes.title: Magical Monday (July 2021 Update)
notes.content:
[h1]So happy to see your face again![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/001fd240340956dfc0e97ef2fed7c825b1ede060.png[/img]

[h2]We’ve got lots to share for this months’ dev update: hope you’re ready! [/h2]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h2]Backer Surveys Are Out![/h2]

Please check your emails if you were a Kickstarter backer, because you should have received Backer Surveys by now! This was our first time doing this (yay, first Kickstarter survey!) so there were some, shall we call them, *learning experiences*. 

We appreciate your patience and kindness as we work through some of them! 
Read all about those details here in the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/softnotweak/spirit-swap/posts/3244670]latest Kickstarter Backer Update[/url].

[h2] Refactoring the Demo into a final game with Morgan![/h2]

[i]This month, we finished up a MAJOR refactor of the game! Here’s a note from Morgan, our Lead Programmer, sharing a bit more on what they worked on: [/i]

"Hiya, I’m Morgan, the Lead Programmer! It turns out, it’s really difficult to write good code and make a good project structure, while also making a vertical slice of an entire game! Because of that, a lot of the demo was held together by duct tape and dreams (if you played at very fast speeds, you might have noticed some areas got a little rough around the edges). 

In a lot of ways, the demo was just a rough draft, so I spent this month just going through everything and cleaning it up. Polishing some edges, fixing some bugs, and restructuring some things so that we can build on it later. Now, everything’s all nice and organized and I’m ready to start adding new stuff, and hopefully I can show you some next month!"

[h2]Beach Episode! [/h2]

In addition to refactoring the code (which doesn’t have a pretty picture) we’ve also been working on concepting environments in the game. Ishk, for example, spends lots of time at Muscle Beach for …. obvious reasons. Check out [url=https://www.artstation.com/adrielxyz]Adriel’s[/url] concept art for this sunny locale: 

[url=https://www.artstation.com/adrielxyz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/90d61fc782b5d5b6ace136f925a03cd32f55349b.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.artstation.com/adrielxyz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/2600fd0e58ad7c1ba57261f30b98550054da221d.png[/img]
[i](The fishies will SWIM!!) [/i][/url]


[h2]Rotating Froggo[/h2]

We also have had [url=https://thedicegoddess.com/]Dice [/url]working on a character sheet for Froggo because -secret reasons we will reveal in time- (I mean, look at Froggo?! No reason is even needed). So, for anyone interested in what Froggo looks like from the side and back, behold! 
 
[url=https://thedicegoddess.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/dd0ec4a2ee3731b22f86814fb84d7502d07d24ce.png[/img][/url]

[h2]We’d love your help![/h2]

Want to know one way you can help us as we make the game? By wishlisting Spirit Swap on Steam (and maybe even helping spread the word for others to do the same). 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592170/Spirit_Swap_Lofi_Beats_to_Match3_To/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40304583/a971f79a6cf20a67bf7298aa180692f38ed5f60f.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What do YOU want to know?[/h2]

As we’re diving into development, we’d love to hear from you! What do you want to know more about? The magical cast of characters? World lore? More gameplay? We want to make sure we’re sharing what you’re most excited about! Find us on [url=twitter.com/softnotweak]Twitter[/url], or hop into our [url=https://discord.gg/pSYhWbq2J8]Discord [/url](we're open for hanging out from 9 - 5 PM PST!). Can't wait to hear from you!

Until next time!

Love, [url=twitter.com/softnotweak]The Spirit Swap Team[/url]
